title: Confirm your new email
description: Enter the new address that received this link. Your current address stays active until confirmation.
emailHelp: Use the new email address, not your current address.
pendingHelp: Your current address remains active. Confirm the new address using the link sent to it, valid for one hour.
success: Email confirmed. Previous sessions were closed; sign in with your new address.
unavailable: Email confirmation is unavailable. Your current address remains active. Try again later.
rateLimited: Wait one minute before requesting another link.
invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired. Sign in with your current address to request another.
emailTaken: This email is already in use. Your current address remains active.
